resample_backtranslations: These are not his twins in heaven. This is his twin. || These are not his two up in the sky. These are his two. || These two above are not his. These two are his.

If you want to feed the deer that come near you, be very patient and avoid making sudden movements. A deer will not become tame right away. Feeding deer. || If you are feeding deer, they may be wary of what you put out, so be patient and leave it undisturbed for several days. Deer will not come right away during the day. Feeding deer. || If he is eating when the guests I invited arrive, do not disturb him, because he has had nothing to eat all day. He has not eaten in a long time. He is a big eater.

A hunter there on the mountain produces game. The game there on the mountain provides food. A hunter there on the mountain provides food. || A farmer on the mountain raises animals. The animals on the mountain produce food. The farmer on the mountain produces food. || The farmer on the mountain produces crops. The crops on the mountain produce food. The farmer on the mountain produces food.

Maya is north of Norway. Noah is north of Lavmi. Maya is north of Lavmi. || Maya is north of Noah. Noah is north of Lavmi. Maya is north of Lavmi. || Maya is north of Noah. Noah is north of Ravi. Maya is north of Ravi.

My turn is a little later. There is a little while before my turn. || I will go to bed in a little while. It will be a little while before I go to bed. || The crossing is a little behind it. It is a little in front of the crossing.
